article.headline: Duke transfer Darren Harris scores career-high 23 for Indiana in 92-69 win over Bellarmine
article.description: — Duke transfer Darren Harris made five 3-pointers and scored a career-high 23 points, Bryce Lindsay added 15 points, and Indiana beat Bellarmine 92-69 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Duke transfer Darren Harris scores career-high 23 for Indiana in 92-69 win over Bellarmine
article.story: BLOOMINGTON, Ind. -- — Duke transfer Darren Harris made five 3-pointers and scored a career-high 23 points, Bryce Lindsay added 15 points, and Indiana beat Bellarmine 92-69 on Thursday night. Lindsay, who averaged 12.3 points per game last season at Villanova, scored nine points in the first 11 minutes as the Hoosiers jumped to a 22-7 lead. Harris had five consecutive points in a 10-2 surge that made it a 24-point game at halftime. Lindsay's layup with 4:15 left gave Indiana its biggest lead at 84-54. Bellarmine (0-2) trailed by double figures for the final 31-plus minutes. Tyler Doyle scored 12 points and Jacob Wassler added 10 for the Knights. Aiden Sherrell and Sam Alexis scored 12 points apiece for Indiana (2-0). Trevor Manhertz, who scored 11 points in his college debut on Monday, had nine on 3-of-4 shooting. The Hoosiers shot 50% from the field, made 12 3-pointers and outscored the Knights 21-6 in second-chance points. Markus Burton, a Notre Dame transfer had who scored 19 points in the opener, had two points on 0-of-7 shooting with four assists and no turnovers against Bellarmine. Up next Bellarmine: Plays Saturday at Miami (Ohio). Indiana: Plays Syracuse on Monday at the Bad Boy Mowers Series in Indianapolis. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
